title: Support container keys in AppTest
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

As far as I can tell, containers show up as "Block" of type "flex_container" in AppTest? It would be very useful if those blocks had the key specified in the app instead of "None" as it is today. 

```
#10 15.95     _tree={
#10 15.95         0: SpecialBlock(
#10 15.95             type='main',
#10 15.95             children={
#10 15.95                 0: UnknownElement(),
#10 15.95                 1: Block(
#10 15.95                     type='flex_container',
#10 15.95                     children={
#10 15.95                         0: UnknownElement()
#10 15.95                     }
#10 15.95                 ),
```

### Why?

This would allow for much easier targeted testing of sections of the app. Today, finding areas of the app requires hardcoding navigation steps inside the element tree

Thanks and keep up the great work!

### How?

_No response_
